notes.title: Final Release Progress - Five
notes.notes: [p]UPDATE[/p][p]A quick update because work towards the final version is happening at a feverish pace. A playtesting build is very close now. The last few months have been focused on so many things across the entire game and I'm happy to say that the list of items to be complete is now very small.[/p][p][/p][p]STORY[/p][p]Much of the progress of late has been to add all of the story moments between levels and in level cinematic moments. There has been a lot missing to truly tell the story and now most of these elements are complete.[/p][p][/p][p]The Story of the stone - Part One[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31420941/d463f3b234aa1471b3d39b1a9aaf4203811ea5cc.jpg"][/img][/p][p]The Story of the Stone - Part Two[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31420941/64a11d54dcdbded86fe234fec163f2e346e927a0.jpg"][/img][/p][p]WEAPONS[/p][p]All weapons and finalized now have ammo requirements that you will need to collect in the world from stashes, enemies or other means. [/p][p]Two new gameplay features have been added with these 2 new grenade types, that I just call "Splode Balls". Very interesting little things you can collect from certain plants and store for the right moments.[/p][p][/p][p]Poison Ball[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31420941/c8daff7279b2d81e5b03a44889c9e06e6ec1d967.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Shock Ball[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31420941/facd440f736848abb158f182e187a5b885b97fc1.jpg"][/img][/p][p]RPG ELEMENTS[/p][p]In your home cave you will now level up  your character in areas such as, Sprint, Health, Armor, Time and the mysterious worship stat.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31420941/235b9120c056f685b6cdf9de817aea5bfee775c1.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]THANK YOU[/p][p]Once again I thank everyone for their patience in waiting for this final version. It is progressing daily. I want to explain why the game has not been updated from it's current form for such a long time. The project I am working on and towards is completely new as I had to scrap the entire game about 2 years ago and start again.  I have not updated the main game yet is as it's radically different than the old version (in a very good way) but the entire game cannot be finished yet as all the levels have not been joined together and there are some blockers along the way. I think people might get upset if they can't complete the game at the moment. Joining all the levels together is close but it's not been a priority yet as I would rather have everything feeling great and as all the levels are done, they just need a few days of dealing with end battles and some bosses that are way too hard. Once that is ready it shall be released. I really look forward to that day very soon. Thank you again[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Final Release Progress - Four
notes.notes:
[b]PLAYTESTING SOON[/b]

I'm very happy to announce that the new totally reimagined version of Primordian that has been worked on day and night for the last 2 years is finally very close to completion. Within a few weeks from now it will be ready for some beta branch play testing. Feel free to message in the discussion thread for playtesting that you would like to be involved and added to the group, as your feedback and thoughts would be most valuable and very much appreciated. It will be a huge help to make this 7 year journey worth the wait for everyone. ːsteamhappyː
Here is an image of the all new menu system that will be included.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31420941/1b5ad969761c81210cdf44e53662ab4cbde71ae1.jpg[/img]

[b]STRANGE FRUITS[/b]

Meeko Bean, Tongo Berry are just a few of the strange fruits you will need to add to your skill set to grant things like full health, invulnerability, enemy confusion and stealth to your combat arsenal. 
You will also learn how to collect items to grow and craft these fruits in your home cave. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31420941/ddb3ab0f66943448441fa0c3ad959b3941cc04a3.jpg[/img]

[b]LIGHT TEMPLE GUARDIANS[/b]

This tribe will be defending the final areas of the game if you are skillful enough to reach the light temple. They will use many varied skills and attacks to stop you at any cost. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31420941/311d8ed788dd1b39a495cf0d1e4076106c9551c1.jpg[/img]


Thank you all again for the continued interest in seeing Primordian to it's completion, it has been apparent to me for a long time now that the only way to make this journey worth while for all who have supported the early access version for so long is to make it's final version undeniably polished and great. So it will not be released from early access until that is the case. Your help with playtesting if you are interested will be invaluable.

Look for new video trailers, screenshots and promotional artwork coming soon as well. Yay!

notes.title: Final Release Progress - Three
notes.notes:
SWORD FIGHTING
Since the last progress update a huge amount of work has gone into the enemies and combat, particularly melee combat with the different types of sword fighters. It's a long process to get this melee combat feeling great. Actually fighting against these enemies for countless hours, weeks, even years :) to feel and tweak how they move and react to your human moves. I've implemented a system that predicts where your sword swings are trying to hit on their body or armor and the enemy can counter your moves, dodge and jump out of the way, parry, punch you back, headbutt, steal your weapon and kick as well as other tactics. Some of this can be seen in the video here. 

[previewyoutube=_RDWjLKtuPg;full][/previewyoutube]
They have a random intelligence and agility level and sometimes you will come up against a sword fighter that is so good at dodging your attacks you could swear it's another human.
Melee combat was the main item people recommended be worked on more during early access and so I didn't want it to be just good or ok, I want it to be great. 


MORG - IRON TRIBE
You will find the Iron Tribe only in the depths of the past
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31420941/90b76a5a2a734334cd0a28205ae2d911d3e55fda.jpg[/img]

WEAPON - JAVELIN
The Javelin throwing enemy class will send many of these towards you, high damage ranged weapon. Try to catch it and throw it back to turn the tables,
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31420941/7f05f928d68239b7626e29822312a97e502f2bad.jpg[/img]

CLEYTORS
The little creatures can be lured out of their home and will follow you as a helpful companion, electrocuting the nearest enemy, or even yourself if you are not careful. They don't care. If they get to annoying you can pick them up to use as a shield.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31420941/aaad472c08a2f20736cacba789bf609391494c18.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Getting Ready! Major Milestone.
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31420941/16fc643ab3756cad4b235f70a8f5895fc5aef653.jpg[/img]

Major Milestone hit in the game progress today!
4 Months ago now I stared on the journey of recreating the entire game from scratch, yet again. Rethinking everything along the way to take into account all new VR hardware and to make it the absolute best it can be, all shiny and new for 2023 VR game standards.
Very happy to report that as of today the game is feeling and looking better than I could have ever hoped and is now ready to go into the final phase of non stop testing and non stop polish. 

Very excited to finally be able to release the ultimate version soon that takes the game out of early access sometime in the next few months, just as soon as it is perfect and every possible issue is solved.
Testing, optimizing, gathering feedback, perfecting, just takes a long time, but well worth it.
I really want to thank everyone who has played / purchased or followed the game to this point for waiting so long for this release, you are the reason that every day perfecting this is so exciting, rewarding and worth every minute.

notes.title: The Evolving Game
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31420941/8065178d7d7bc7ce49bb7285447301fe384781cc.jpg[/img]

TLDR Version - After total engine update, Primordian is being rebuilt from the ground up to be better, stronger, and faster before the final release.

Lots of news regarding plans for the final version of Primordian.

After recently completing all levels for the entire game, Parts 1, 2 and 3 to bring it to a complete state and plan for the major update (not released yet).
Then playing through many times with wishlist notes and many pages of feedback from the excellent thoughts on the forum and reviews so far from everyone playing in mind.
I was more than excited to be close to a final version.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31420941/2fd40051065e0e82cdf10abf87879d3942ddeefa.jpg[/img]

However *dramatic music here*
It became very apparent that since the game started development almost 3 years ago, elements of the game engine needed major updates to achieve all the final goals and speed up the process. 

Physics, lighting, terrain, Audio, VR components etc etc all stuck in the past. It was the only way forward to be able to deliver a more advanced gameplay and visuals and bring in new techniques for 2019. 
This is always risky and a major undertaking. So with many backups safely tucked away the update process was started. It was indeed rough! The game fell down some stairs, was run over by a passing truck, washed down a drain pipe, floated out to sea in a huge storm and eventually came to rest on a remote beach, unconscious and gasping for air.
All that remained was the Levels for the game, sound, characters and weapons.
*end dramatic music*

Being rebuilt currently from the ground up for the super version of Primordian is, UI, Main Player, Combat, NPC's, Skills, VFX, Weapons, Ambient Creatures, Save Systems, Lighting, additional modes and basically everything.
New features will be added such add subtitles in many languages, English, German, Russian, French and Italian to start with.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31420941/8099c2df459a04cd9c9e2075bd9087d96ae0f433.jpg[/img]

The great news about this is that it is also a much faster process to rebuild, things that previously might take 6 days can be done in 6 hours and as a more polished version of its former self, thanks to hindsight, new tech, reviews and feedback.
Maybe even some secret additions that can't be talked about yet.
The game now has 0 errors, 0 bugs and runs very fast.

So,
To be it's best, I personally think the game should be an evolving thing that will just continue to evolve as VR technology evolves, to keep up, experiment, but also try to push some of the limits if possible into the future of new technology around the corner. Somehow along the way of the sheer amount of work I had forgotten about this idea and it was not until completing the game story that I had a chance to sit back and really assess it as a whole.
Then figured, since it's taken this long, it really needs to be done perfectly, even if that takes a little longer.
Although I would love nothing more than for it to be complete tomorrow.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31420941/39cfd8578ff608e6383705131e52b2f4a86f361c.jpg[/img]

I can't state enough how much the support, ideas and words of those who have enjoyed the game in early access and also taken the time to comment on the good and bad about the game so far have helped to keep progress moving along but also to really give the drive to make it absolutely the best version of itself it can be.
What I was seeing of the game once all put together was not close enough to perfect, so apologies for the extended delay in bringing out the final version but I believe once everyone finally gets a chance to play it from the beginning again you will see it was very well worth while.

So what does this all mean? when will it be done, how much will things change.
The honest answer is, not sure just yet, and a lot:)

Thank you everyone!

J

Hi,
Part Three of the game is progressing well. It has been a little while since an update but everything is moving along.

The game has now been in early access for over one year! wow, It was never the plan to spend so long, but hearing all of the great thoughts and ideas for the game from the day it was released right up to now has meant a huge amount of time spent going over and over the first few hours of the game. Well worth it also I think and so wanted to thank everyone who has supported, enjoyed and also contributed ideas to the game so far. Thank you also for your patience as the last important section is added.

Even though the game has been in early access for 1 Year, it took 2 years to get to the point of first release in Jan 2018. So after three years and now that work is commencing on the very final scene and Boss fight,  it's quite a strange feeling that seemed so far way all those years ago:)..

New weapons for Part Three are going to be pretty interesting, hopefully!. The first Rapid fire rifle in the game and a boomerang style weapon. Both seen in the image above.
There are also some really cool music Tracks created by Vince that have gone into Part Three that really make the final scenes and give them that special mood.

In other news Primordian was voted "Best Alien World" in the The VR365 Game of the Year Awards 2018. If you are into VR and want a great fun daily news show check out VR365.

Thank you also to everyone who has taken the time to leave a review of the game, reading them has been a huge motivation at times when It was really needed:) 
What will be added in Part three of the game is probably the most interesting and unique parts of the game so far..can't wait to have them out to you.

Will keep updates coming and thank you again everyone!.
J

notes.title: Mega Update
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31420941/912f8c055ec471ba05e61044de0fb630cb697d50.jpg[/img]

MEGA UPDATE
This update is the result of going through all reviews, feedback, requests, issues and ideas on our forum and main page. It has been excellent, challenging and fun to attempt to tackle everything in what was a pretty huge list, so it’s very exciting to release this update today.
Thank you to everyone who took the time to leave thoughts, reviews and requests, I hope you enjoy all the changes.
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=W-TJfcR1s0s&feature=youtu.be
NEW IN THIS UPDATE
Short Version
Improved weapon physics and weight simulation
Player Armor System
Vive Weapon Swap Double Click
New Home Cave and Menu
Teleport (Early Version)
Snap Turn, Smooth Turn rotation options
Game Difficulty Options x 3
Graphic Setting Options x 3
Audio Options
New Weapon (Club)
Player Taunt Enemy
Extended and Improved Levels
New Part Three level preview
Faster Player Speed and Improved Dash and FX
Improved Damage feedback and UI
Improved FX entire game
Improved AI
Improved Combat feedback
Improved Enemy spawning in some levels
Slow Motion Polish
Audio Polish
Recharge Life if Health Eaten before fade out
New Cinematic Scene
Item Colour polish for better overall feedback
Many Many other small items and improvements

KNOWN ISSUES
There are a couple of known issues that will be fixed over the next few updates, including - Teleport polish, it is possible to teleport anywhere currently, not ideal and so over the next few updates a restricted path for Teleport will be added to all levels, 
Floating when dashing on steep hills, 
Occasional Xbow staying active, 
Menu pointer will lose focus when removing HMD correct this by entering a level and coming back (fix coming soon). 
Check your graphic setting mode from time to time as it is possible for the game to drop to a lower setting sometimes (no f’n idea why! but will be fixed)

GUARDIAN MODE
The new gameplay mode Guardian is very close to ready but since it was feeling very fun even in the current state I want to take the time it needs to make it more awesome and present it in a new update as soon as possible. Some images of new levels can be seen in video above.

PART THREE
Part Three free update of the game is coming together and will be the next big item after Guardian mode. Some scenes from Part Three can be seen in the above video, and one scene has been included with this current update as a kind of preview, for no reason other than It seemed like a good moment to add as a break between action.

NEXT STEPS
Improvements and changes will continue at the same time as completing the new mode and Part Three of the story.
Part Two of the story is still in a first version state and will be review and improved also.
Some levels have been removed from this update and will appear later in the story.
Much more to come, thank you again everyone and hope the mega update is enjoyable.
A small note is that many things have changed early on in the game also, so it’s a good time to start the game again from scratch if it’s been a while since you played.
J

notes.title: Part Two in Bite Size Chunks - Starting Today!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31420941/26f968ad27258d673bb613b3ac4ae45d692781c7.jpg[/img]

Hi,
Yes, finally here!,
It's been way too long between updates for the game, thank you everyone for your patience. 

This update includes the first 4 levels of Part Two.

Originally, Part Two of the story was planned to be released all as one giant update. However the size of the update has become so complex that, releasing a hand full of levels on a weekly-ish basis will be the best way to go.

So in the spirit of "Early Access" everything is very much work in progress, the first 4 levels will change dramatically as the weeks progress. The plan is to have at least one new level or more per week added to the game. Including all of the upcoming Part Three. Until the whole thing is complete.! That will be a cool moment:).
So please forgive any issues or temporary problems. I want to assure everyone that all requests for items like teleport, control options etc etc are also all on the way and will work their way in to the game slowly through these weekly updates.
all your thoughts and ideas are very valuable to the game, so looking forward to hear them all on the forum if you have time.

Going forward, once all Parts of the game Story are complete, the next phases will be to go over the entire game again to include missing cinematics, do all game play polish. Complete every feature request and then..add some of the secret wish list modes, hopefully something online with swords and whips.

Thank you again and hope you enjoy this first chunk of Part Two. More to come on a regular basis now very soon.
J

Quick Tip - Crack it like a real life whip!

Here is a small video showing only sections of this first chunk of Part Two.
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=JVJLEp3wahA&feature=youtu.be

notes.title: Big Combat Update - Phase One
notes.notes:
Hi,
Here is a new Update focused on Combat, adding new enemies and enemy types, new music, environment traps, a new Boss and changes to original levels among many, many other things listed below. Here is a short video showing all of this.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6rxk1ZidsdU&feature=youtu.be

This is the first of what will be group of updates focused around combat.
Optimization to enemy spawning and continued game optimizations were also a large focus with this update, allowing for more enemies in battle than previously.
Tip - Storing health pickups and consuming head trophy’s is now essential to progressing.

We are calling this Phase One, with more phases coming over the next few weeks.
This phase focuses on the first hour or so only, although changes to the enemy AI will be noticed through the entire game. It covers the levels, “Ancient Blade to Ijhee the endless” It is recommended to start a new game from the beginning if you want to see everything that has changed.
We think this direction feels good and are hard at work applying this polish to the remainder of Part One over the next few weeks! We are aiming for an update each week until all of Part One has been covered, while also continuing to work on Part Two of the story.
Lots of details below, thank you everyone for the great feedback and thoughts on the game and we look forward to hear more.

SHORT NOTES 
Added Checkpoints
Added Boss and Level - Arcledon
Added New Enemy “Chungaah’s” 
Added Morg Grenadier
Added Morg Helmet Grunt
Added Environment Traps
Added Start for Combo’s - Savage Mode
Polished Levels 0 to 7
Added new Music to many scenes
Added Short Cinematic scene
Improved almost all Audio FX
Improved Combat - Morg Grunt
Improved Combat - Charger
Improved Combat - Mage
Improved Combat - Heavy
Gamewide Optimizations
Optimized enemy Spawning
Added small health pickup item
Improved Pickup Items
Many other items

LONG NOTES
Added Checkpoints - For levels “Ancient Blade and Dawn Cave” you can now restart close to your current location rather than starting at the beginning.
Added Boss and Level - Arcledon - This is a whole new level with a Boss character Arcledon. Arcledon is the keeper of the Gambaou weapon. There is also a smaller new level at the end of this scene called “Double Gambaou”, if you make it!
Added New Enemy “Chungaah’s” - The halfling outcast tribe of the Morg, tree dwelling angry little beasts.
Added Morg Grenadier - He will slow time and throw traps in your direction, be very careful with how to take him out as he will splode in a colourful shower of acid if you hit the wrong location. Tip, go for the helmet then head and back away very quickly.
Added Morg Helmet Grunt - A stronger version of the base Morg warrior.
Added Environment Traps - The first two of a variety of traps to be added, Tip they can all be deactivated, you just need to figure out how.
Added Start for Combo’s - Savage Mode - This is the base for what will become a combo system for combat that will multiply and reward you based on the speed that you can take out enemies.
Polished Levels 0 to 7 - While levels 0 to 7 all received polish, the level dawn cave has undergone some large changes in the second half of the level. Mainly visual, but much improved.
Added new Music to many scenes - Some awesome new Vince music tracks carefully created for the new scenes.
Added Short Cinematic scene - Short action scene at end of Arcledon level.
Improved almost all Audio FX - Many of the weapon and combat sounds needed some refinement, balancing and touches.
Improved Combat - Morg Grunt - Now with active vision, will only attack when in range. Will be very aggressive at close range. Will not fight with Traps.
Improved Combat - Morg Charger - Charges from range, more aggressive.
Improved Combat - Morg Mage - Summons cave bats
Improved Combat - Morg Heavy - Much more aggressive, uses active vision to switch attacks mid action based on your moves. Will Tag team with a second Heavy. Can be chopped in half if Chest armor is removed.
Gamewide Optimizations - Hundreds
Optimized Enemy Spawning - for Levels 0 to 7 spawning of enemies in handled in a new way and so you should not see any FPS drop or slow down when an enemy enters the battle.
Added small health pickup item - Mini health is now collected from Pots that contain a random drop of the “Tongo Berry”
Improved Pickup Items “Pickup items are now more appropriate for weapon and level. Work on this will be ongoing.

notes.title: Update 03
notes.notes:
Hi,
This new update adds the larger features listed below.
A Tutorial
New Starting Area and Menu
Pause Mode
Snap Turn
Smooth Turn
Aim arc for Trapball
Many Game Optimizations, Fixes and Improvements
New Music

It is a huge help to us if you find any issues with this update that cause you problems to let us know on the community page and we will get them all fixed right away!
If you like/love or dislike anything also good to know:) 
We really value the support you have show by playing the game in early access and want to honor that support by listening and improving constantly. So anything no matter how small, we'll get on it!

A special thank you to Sebastian from Frame Tale Studios
http://www.frametalestudios.com/
Sebastian makes amazing tools for game developers among other things, as well as his own VR games. We are very fortunate that he answered the call to help out with getting the infrastructure and movement systems into a better state so that going forward we are building on a solid base. I wanted to introduce Sebastian and thank him for his awesome help with this update. He has also been working on a good solution for Teleporting that will come very soon.

Another special thank you to community member and long time testing helper Aerowyn for feedback on the menu and tutorial as it progressed!

Vince has created a new music track for the starting area that no matter how many times I hear it, it still gets me, it's beautiful! Vince has also been creating a huge amount of amazing new music for Part Two. He is also responsible for the ideas behind a new game play mode that will be coming soon called cloud breaker! As well as testing very early versions of Part Two areas.

Additional Notes - 
.There are also many more items not listed that were worked on and included over the last month.
.It is possible that this update will delete any save games you have, apologies for this, unavoidable with some changes we needed to make and it should be a one time thing. For this reason you can go to the location in the starting area "Your Path" and choose the point of the game you were last at and the game will re save your progress from there.

Coming Next -
Teleport
Blade Master Enemy (Part One)
Korrila Enemy (Part One)
Big Boss (Part One End)
Secret Pets
Secret Levels
New Gameplay modes
New Arcade mode map
Endless Jungle
Part Two

Thank you again everyone and hope you enjoy:)
J

PS, try out using the pause mode mid battle or in other places in the game it's pretty fun.

notes.title: Update 02
notes.notes:
Hi,
This update has many items, some notes below.
Thank you everyone and also if any issues, please let us know and will get them fixed:)

UPDATE 02
SHORT NOTES

AUTO SAVE GAMES CORRECTED
MANY OVERALL GAME OPTIMIZATIONS
MANY OVERALL LEVEL OPTIMIZATIONS
SPRINT SPEED INCREASED
AMMO SAVE ISSUE FIXED
ITEM SAVE ISSUE FIXED
INCORRECT LEVEL IN AREAS OF THE WORLD FIXED
TORCH POSITION FIXED
ARCADE MODE CAN NOW BE PLAYED IN ENDLESS LOOP
ARCADE MODE ENEMY RANDOMIZATION
ARCADE MODE AUDIO CHANGES
ARCADE MODE SPEED MULTIPLY MECHANIC ADDED
MANY OTHER SMALL ITEMS


LONG NOTES
AUTO SAVE GAMES CORRECTED - Should be all working as intended now, thankfully, apologies for the inconvenience there.
MANY OVERALL GAME OPTIMIZATIONS - To many to list
MANY OVERALL LEVEL OPTIMIZATIONS - Optimizations to 75% of levels, occlusion culling improvements, audio and texture compression improvements.
SPRINT SPEED INCREASE - Sprint speed increased by around 15%
AMMO SAVE ISSUE FIXED - All working
ITEM SAVE ISSUE FIXED - all working
INCORRECT LEVEL IN AREAS OF THE WORLD FIXED - The last level “The Sacred Spore” had an incorrect load to a work in progress level when selected through the “Santuary”
TORCH POSITION FIXED - Rotated to better match Vive wands
ARCADE MODE CAN NOW BE PLAYED IN ENDLESS LOOP - All day
ARCADE MODE ENEMY RANDOMIZATION - Random enemy will spawn with variation in chance through arcade mode.
ARCADE MODE AUDIO CHANGES - Audio Polish
ARCADE MODE SPEED MULTIPLY MECHANIC ADDED - New Mechanic now possible due to endless loop play mode. 
MANY OTHER SMALL ITEMS - put that thing there, move that there, get rid of that stupid thing over there etc:)

COMING NEXT

SNAP TURN - Snap turn will come very quickly in a new update and will also be a menu option
MENU OVERHAUL - Main menu will receive a complete overhaul to accommodate all feature and change requests as well as fix general usability issues with the current version. This is underway and will be ready soon.
TUTORIAL SCENE - Already underway and will be included in an update. A temporary additional video tutorial is coming asap for anyone not afraid of some spoilers.
PAUSE GAME - With be an item on wrist menu, player will mediate in the air while contemplating the battle so far.
TELEPORT - Teleport Movement on the way.
CHECKPOINTS - In Level checkpoints will be added
MOVEMENT STUTTER ISSUE - Seen by some players is being worked on.
OVERALL PERFORMANCE - Issues with some Graphics Cards and Overall Performance work will continue and be added to regular updates.
ADDITIONAL ARCADE MODE LEVEL - One new arcade mode level will be added very soon
OVERALL COMBAT - Combat is an ongoing work in progress and changes will be included over time and noted in short notes as they are included in updates. Larger changes will be included with Part TWO.
ARROW THROUGH WALLS FIX

notes.title: First Update
notes.notes:
Hi,
Thank you everyone, it has been an amazing time, getting to see and hear everyone actually playing the game, really amazing!. We are truley grateful to everyone who is taking time to leave reviews, feedback and thoughts on the game in this first version. Videos we have seen have also been blowing our minds:)!
Incredibly helpful to help us form a plan for anything that needs to improve and very motivational! 

On that note, a first Update has been made that included two of the top mentioned issues. Here are all the details below.

SHORT NOTES

LOCOMOTION SELECTION - There was an issue with selection not highlighting correctly, this has been fixed and positions moved to the right side near control info.

LONG NOTES

SWORD POSITION - Has been changed to reflect Vive Wand due to multiple requests, now default. This will be an option shortly when new main menu is complete. If anyone prefered the older sword position, this will soon be an option in new menu within the next few days. Apologies for the temporary change if this is not suited to you. Taugohl Sword in the area “Initiation of Grygor” has not been corrected yet and will be changed in coming updates.
SMOOTH TURN - This has been added as a default and will shortly be an optional selection in the main menu, after main menu overhaul, coming soon. Maybe too fast or too slow for some currently? Please feel free to leave thoughts. A speed range for this will also be added as menu option in new menu. SNAP TURN is also coming just in next update.
LOCOMOTION SELECTION - This issue with selection is fixed and moved into a more visible position, it will also be part of a main menu overhaul soon.

COMING NEXT

SNAP TURN - Snap turn will come very quickly in a new update and will also be a menu option
MENU OVERHAUL - Main menu will receive a complete overhaul to accommodate all feature and change requests as well as fix general usability issues with the current version. This is underway and will be ready soon.
SAVE GAME FIXES - Save games have issues and will be fixed asap including addition of manual save on the wrist menu.
TUTORIAL SCENE - Already underway and will be included in an update. A temporary additional video tutorial is coming asap for anyone not afraid of some spoilers.
PAUSE GAME - With be an item on wrist menu, player will meditate in the air while contemplating the battle so far.
CHECKPOINTS - In Level checkpoints will be added
MOVEMENT STUTTER ISSUE - Seen by some players is being worked on.
OVERALL PERFORMANCE - Issues with some Graphics Cards and Overall Performance work will continue and be added to regular updates.
ADDITIONAL ARCADE MODE LEVEL - One new arcade mode level will be added very soon
OVERALL COMBAT - Combat is an ongoing work in progress and changes will be included over time and noted in short notes as they are included in updates. Larger changes will be included with Part TWO.

Thank you, for your patience and great thoughts on everything so far!:)
There are many more items that have been raised not listed here, however they are also compiled in a large list and will be addressed at the same time as all other items currently in progress. We are looking forward to having a first round of all these issues resolved so that we can have Part Two of the story out asap!

J
